title.en: 12 injured, including six children, in shooting near Florida A&M University homecoming
title.zh_hant: 佛羅里達農工大學返校節槍擊　12人受傷包括六名兒童　一人危殆
title.zh_hans: 佛罗里达农工大学返校节枪击　12人受伤包括六名儿童　一人危殆

summary.en: At least 12 people, including six children, were injured in a shooting near Florida A&M University in Tallahassee on Saturday night, during the school's homecoming weekend. Police said 11 people suffered gunshot wounds and one person was hurt while fleeing, after a fight broke out in a crowded area near Perry Street and the university's Bragg Memorial Stadium following the homecoming football game. Tallahassee police said on Sunday that six victims remained in hospital, one of them in critical condition, and five had been discharged. Police Chief Lawrence Revell said no arrests had been made and no deaths had been reported, and the university said the campus remained safe.
summary.zh_hant: 美國佛羅里達州塔拉哈西佛羅里達農工大學附近星期六晚發生槍擊，正值學校返校節周末，至少12人受傷，包括六名兒童。警方表示，事發於返校節美式足球賽後，佩里街及大學布拉格紀念體育場附近人多擠迫的地方，現場先發生打鬥，隨後有人開槍；11人中槍受傷，另一人逃跑時受傷。塔拉哈西警方星期日表示，六名傷者仍然留醫，其中一人危殆，五人已經出院。警察局長雷維爾表示未有人被捕，亦無人死亡，大學表示校園仍然安全。
summary.zh_hans: 美国佛罗里达州塔拉哈西佛罗里达农工大学附近星期六晚发生枪击，正值学校返校节周末，至少12人受伤，包括六名儿童。警方表示，事发于返校节美式足球赛后，佩里街及大学布拉格纪念体育场附近人多挤迫的地方，现场先发生打斗，随后有人开枪；11人中枪受伤，另一人逃跑时受伤。塔拉哈西警方星期日表示，六名伤者仍然留医，其中一人危殆，五人已经出院。警察局长雷维尔表示未有人被捕，亦无人死亡，大学表示校园仍然安全。

title.en: Musk says SpaceX did restrict Ukraine's Starlink as Kyiv says service is restored
title.zh_hant: 馬斯克承認 SpaceX 曾限制烏克蘭星鏈服務　基輔稱服務已恢復正常
title.zh_hans: 马斯克承认 SpaceX 曾限制乌克兰星链服务　基辅称服务已恢复正常

summary.en: Elon Musk has said his company SpaceX did restrict Ukraine's use of the Starlink satellite system, after Kyiv said the service and the military version Starshield were back to full speed following more than a week of disruption. Musk wrote on X that Ukraine's military had violated Starlink's terms of service by using it for offensive drone strikes, and that the loophole had been closed last week. Ukrainian officials said the restrictions, which cut connections for drones flying faster than about 160 kilometres per hour, had hampered efforts to intercept Russian attack drones and forced some operations to be cancelled. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said speeds had returned to normal overnight, and the defence ministry said connections were stable above 400 kilometres per hour. Kyiv pushed back on Musk's claim, with a presidential adviser saying Ukraine is physically unable to use commercial Starlink for long-range drone strikes, while Musk said Starshield is run by the US government.
summary.zh_hant: 馬斯克表示，旗下 SpaceX 確實曾限制烏克蘭使用星鏈衛星系統，此前基輔稱星鏈及軍用版星盾服務在中斷超過一星期後已恢復全速運作。馬斯克在社交平台 X 發文稱，烏克蘭軍方違反星鏈服務條款，利用系統進行攻擊性無人機襲擊，有關漏洞上星期已被堵塞。烏克蘭官員表示，限制措施令時速超過約160公里的無人機失去衛星連接，妨礙攔截俄羅斯攻擊無人機的工作，部分行動被迫取消。總統澤連斯基表示，速度已於一夜之間恢復正常；國防部稱連接穩定，時速超過400公里。基輔反駁馬斯克的說法，總統顧問稱烏克蘭實際上無法利用商用星鏈進行長程無人機襲擊；馬斯克則稱星盾由美國政府營運。
summary.zh_hans: 马斯克表示，旗下 SpaceX 确实曾限制乌克兰使用星链卫星系统，此前基辅称星链及军用版星盾服务在中断超过一星期后已恢复全速运作。马斯克在社交平台 X 发文称，乌克兰军方违反星链服务条款，利用系统进行攻击性无人机袭击，有关漏洞上星期已被堵塞。乌克兰官员表示，限制措施令时速超过约160公里的无人机失去卫星连接，妨碍拦截俄罗斯攻击无人机的工作，部分行动被迫取消。总统泽连斯基表示，速度已于一夜之间恢复正常；国防部称连接稳定，时速超过400公里。基辅反驳马斯克的说法，总统顾问称乌克兰实际上无法利用商用星链进行长程无人机袭击；马斯克则称星盾由美国政府营运。

title.en: Flávio Bolsonaro narrowly leads Lula in early Brazil runoff count, with 18% of votes tallied
title.zh_hant: 巴西大選次輪點票初期　博索納羅以些微優勢領先盧拉　僅點算18%選票
title.zh_hans: 巴西大选次轮点票初期　博索纳罗以些微优势领先卢拉　仅点算18%选票

summary.en: Flávio Bolsonaro led President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva by a narrow margin in the early count of Brazil's presidential runoff on Sunday, taking 50.35% of valid votes against Lula's 49.65% with 18.37% of electoral sections counted, according to figures from the Superior Electoral Court. Bolsonaro, the 45-year-old senator and son of former president Jair Bolsonaro, held 11,492,231 votes to Lula's 11,334,559, a gap of 157,672 votes, after Lula had led the count in its earliest stages with about 51% when just over 5% of tallies had been reported. The count was delayed after the electoral court paused publication for about two hours, when the Supreme Court extended voting until 7 p.m. in some areas because of public transport problems and heavy rain. The final result was not yet known, with counting continuing into the night in a race the final polls had called a statistical tie.
summary.zh_hant: 巴西總統大選次輪投票星期日點票，初步點算18.37%選區後，博索納羅以50.35%有效票些微領先總統盧拉的49.65%，根據最高選舉法院數字。45歲參議員、亦即前總統博索納羅之子博索納羅得票11,492,231張，盧拉11,334,559張，相差157,672票；點票初期盧拉曾以約51%領先，其後被反超。點票一度延遲，最高法院因部分地區公共交通問題及大雨，將投票延長至晚上7時，選舉法院亦暫停公布點票約兩小時。最終結果尚未出爐，點票持續進行；選前最後民調顯示兩人支持度在誤差範圍內，難分高下。
summary.zh_hans: 巴西总统大选次轮投票星期日点票，初步点算18.37%选区后，博索纳罗以50.35%有效票些微领先总统卢拉的49.65%，根据最高选举法院数字。45岁参议员、亦即前总统博索纳罗之子博索纳罗得票11,492,231张，卢拉11,334,559张，相差157,672票；点票初期卢拉曾以约51%领先，其后被反超。点票一度延迟，最高法院因部分地区公共交通问题及大雨，将投票延长至晚上7时，选举法院亦暂停公布点票约两小时。最终结果尚未出炉，点票持续进行；选前最后民调显示两人支持度在误差范围内，难分高下。

title.en: John Lee says Hong Kong will link green projects, capital and technology at Belt and Road green conference
title.zh_hant: 李家超：「一帶一路」綠色創新大會　香港助綠色項目對接資金技術
title.zh_hans: 李家超：「一带一路」绿色创新大会　香港助绿色项目对接资金技术

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee told the Belt and Road Green Innovation Conference 2026 on Monday that Hong Kong will act as a 'super connector' and 'super value-adder' for green transformation, linking green projects with international capital, green technology with the markets that need it, and partners through credible standards. More than 400 government representatives and professionals from 16 countries attended the conference, the first time the event has been held outside the Chinese mainland, jointly organised with the Ministry of Ecology and Environment. Lee said Hong Kong has led Asia in arranging international green and sustainable bond issuances for eight consecutive years, accounting for about 40 per cent of the regional total, and noted the government priced about HK$20 billion in digital green bonds last month. He also announced the Green Technology Bridgehead Programme will launch next year to help green enterprises reach Belt and Road markets, and said Hong Kong is working on a green hydrogen certification system and its first 'ChaoJi' electric vehicle charging demonstration station.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超今日在「一帶一路」綠色創新大會2026致辭時表示，香港會擔當綠色轉型的「超級聯繫人」和「超級增值人」，協助綠色項目對接國際資金、綠色技術對接有需要的市場，並以可信的標準聯繫合作夥伴。今屆大會首次在中國內地以外舉行，由香港與國家生態環境部合辦，吸引來自16個國家超過400名政府代表及專業人士參與。李家超表示，香港連續八年居亞洲安排國際綠色及可持續債券發行首位，佔區內總量約四成，上月亦發行了約200億港元數碼綠色債券。他又宣布，明年將推出「綠色科技橋頭堡計劃」，協助綠色企業開拓「一帶一路」市場，同時正制訂綠氫標準認證制度，並會設立香港首個「超充」電動車充電技術示範站。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超今日在「一带一路」绿色创新大会2026致辞时表示，香港会担当绿色转型的「超级联系人」和「超级增值人」，协助绿色项目对接国际资金、绿色技术对接有需要的市场，并以可信的标准联系合作伙伴。今届大会首次在中国内地以外举行，由香港与国家生态环境部合办，吸引来自16个国家超过400名政府代表及专业人士参与。李家超表示，香港连续八年居亚洲安排国际绿色及可持续债券发行首位，占区内总量约四成，上月亦发行了约200亿港元数码绿色债券。他又宣布，明年将推出「绿色科技桥头堡计划」，协助绿色企业开拓「一带一路」市场，同时正制订绿氢标准认证制度，并会设立香港首个「超充」电动车充电技术示范站。

title.en: Lula wins Brazil presidential runoff for historic fourth term, defeating Flávio Bolsonaro
title.zh_hant: 盧拉贏得巴西總統大選次輪　歷史性第四度當選總統
title.zh_hans: 卢拉赢得巴西总统大选次轮　历史性第四度当选总统

summary.en: Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has won Brazil's presidential runoff, defeating Senator Flávio Bolsonaro to secure a historic fourth, non-consecutive term as president. With 99.77 per cent of electoral sections counted, Lula took 51.76 per cent of valid votes, 64,078,503, against Bolsonaro's 48.24 per cent, 59,728,246, a margin of 4,350,257 votes, according to the Superior Electoral Court. The result reverses the early count, in which Bolsonaro had led narrowly, and overturns his first-round advantage. Lula, 80, will begin his new term on January 5, 2027, while Bolsonaro has so far refused to concede defeat, according to the Associated Press.
summary.zh_hant: 巴西總統盧拉贏得總統大選次輪投票，擊敗參議員博索納羅，歷史性第四度當選總統。根據最高選舉法院數字，點算99.77%選區後，盧拉得票51.76%（64,078,503票），博索納羅48.24%（59,728,246票），相差4,350,257票。結果扭轉點票初期的形勢，博索納羅當時一度些微領先，亦反超他在首輪投票的優勢。80歲的盧拉將於2027年1月5日展開新任期；據美聯社報道，博索納羅至今未承認落敗。
summary.zh_hans: 巴西总统卢拉赢得总统大选次轮投票，击败参议员博索纳罗，历史性第四度当选总统。根据最高选举法院数字，点算99.77%选区后，卢拉得票51.76%（64,078,503票），博索纳罗48.24%（59,728,246票），相差4,350,257票。结果扭转点票初期的形势，博索纳罗当时一度些微领先，亦反超他在首轮投票的优势。80岁的卢拉将于2027年1月5日展开新任期；据美联社报道，博索纳罗至今未承认落败。

title.en: China voices firm opposition to US proposal to widen curbs on outbound investment
title.zh_hant: 中國堅決反對美國擬擴大對華對外投資限制
title.zh_hans: 中国坚决反对美国拟扩大对华对外投资限制

summary.en: China has expressed 'grave concern' and 'firm opposition' to a recent US Treasury proposal that would expand and intensify restrictions on outbound investment in China, describing it as discriminatory and an overstretching of national security. A spokesperson for the Ministry of Commerce said the proposed updates to the outbound investment security programme, which are open for public comment, run counter to the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and disrupt normal economic and trade cooperation between Chinese and US enterprises. China will closely follow developments and reserves the right to take corresponding measures, the spokesperson said. The spokesperson added that investing in China is investing in the future, given the country's huge market and vast consumption and investment potential.
summary.zh_hant: 中國對美國財政部近日擬擴大及加強對華對外投資限制的建議，表示「嚴重關切」和「堅決反對」，指有關做法具歧視性，是泛化國家安全概念。商務部發言人表示，美國擬修訂的對外投資安全計劃正公開徵求意見，有關建議違反兩國元首達成的重要共識，擾亂中美企業正常經貿合作，損害國際經貿秩序。中方將密切關注事態發展，保留採取相應措施的權利。發言人又表示，投資中國就是投資未來，中國擁有超大規模市場，消費及投資潛力巨大。
summary.zh_hans: 中国对美国财政部近日拟扩大及加强对华对外投资限制的建议，表示「严重关切」和「坚决反对」，指有关做法具歧视性，是泛化国家安全概念。商务部发言人表示，美国拟修订的对外投资安全计划正公开征求意见，有关建议违反两国元首达成的重要共识，扰乱中美企业正常经贸合作，损害国际经贸秩序。中方将密切关注事态发展，保留采取相应措施的权利。发言人又表示，投资中国就是投资未来，中国拥有超大规模市场，消费及投资潜力巨大。

title.en: Hong Kong Customs seizes about $33 million of suspected smuggled goods from river trade vessels
title.zh_hant: 海關破兩宗內河船走私案　檢獲約3,300萬元懷疑走私貨物
title.zh_hans: 海关破两宗内河船走私案　检获约3,300万元怀疑走私货物

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs detected two suspected smuggling cases involving river trade vessels on October 9 and 13, seizing large batches of suspected smuggled goods with a total estimated market value of about $33 million. Through intelligence analysis and risk assessment, officers selected two river trade vessels departing Hong Kong for Macao for inspection and found about 740,000 suspected pharmaceutical products on board. Investigations are ongoing and arrests have not been ruled out. Customs said it will continue to combat sea smuggling through intelligence-based enforcement and targeted operations.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關在10月9日及13日偵破兩宗涉及內河船的懷疑走私案件，檢獲大批懷疑走私貨物，估計總市值約3,300萬元。海關透過情報分析及風險評估，揀選兩艘由香港前往澳門的內河船進行檢查，在船上搜出約74萬件懷疑藥物產品。案件調查仍在進行，不排除有人被捕。海關表示，會繼續透過情報主導的執法策略及針對性行動，堅決打擊海上走私活動。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关在10月9日及13日侦破两宗涉及内河船的怀疑走私案件，检获大批怀疑走私货物，估计总市值约3,300万元。海关透过情报分析及风险评估，拣选两艘由香港前往澳门的内河船进行检查，在船上搜出约74万件怀疑药物产品。案件调查仍在进行，不排除有人被捕。海关表示，会继续透过情报主导的执法策略及针对性行动，坚决打击海上走私活动。

title.en: John Lee meets ecology minister Huang Runqiu to deepen green co-operation
title.zh_hant: 李家超會晤生態環境部部長黃潤秋　深化綠色合作
title.zh_hans: 李家超会晤生态环境部部长黄润秋　深化绿色合作

summary.en: Chief Executive John Lee met the Minister of Ecology and Environment, Huang Runqiu, at Government House on Monday to exchange views on deepening green co-operation, with the Secretary for Environment and Ecology, Tse Chin-wan, also attending. Lee welcomed Huang and his delegation to Hong Kong to officiate at the Belt and Road Green Innovation Conference 2026, the first time the event has been held outside the Chinese mainland, and thanked the country for choosing Hong Kong as the venue. He said Hong Kong will build itself into an international green co-operation hub through the Belt and Road Green Development Co-operation Platform and a sustainable green development training centre, and will continue to promote green transformation, develop zero-carbon and hydrogen energy, and explore cross-boundary carbon trading.
summary.zh_hant: 行政長官李家超今日在禮賓府與生態環境部部長黃潤秋會面，就深化綠色合作交換意見，環境及生態局局長謝展寰亦有出席。李家超歡迎黃潤秋一行來港為「一帶一路」綠色創新大會2026主禮，感謝國家選擇香港作為大會舉辦地點，大會首次在中國內地以外舉行。他表示，香港會透過與生態環境部建立的「一帶一路」綠色發展合作平台及可持續綠色發展培訓中心，建設成為國際綠色合作樞紐，並會繼續推動綠色轉型、發展零碳能源及氫能，以及積極探索跨境碳交易。
summary.zh_hans: 行政长官李家超今日在礼宾府与生态环境部部长黄润秋会面，就深化绿色合作交换意见，环境及生态局局长谢展寰亦有出席。李家超欢迎黄润秋一行来港为「一带一路」绿色创新大会2026主礼，感谢国家选择香港作为大会举办地点，大会首次在中国内地以外举行。他表示，香港会透过与生态环境部建立的「一带一路」绿色发展合作平台及可持续绿色发展培训中心，建设成为国际绿色合作枢纽，并会继续推动绿色转型、发展零碳能源及氢能，以及积极探索跨境碳交易。

title.en: No. 3 alarm fire at waste-to-energy plant on artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau
title.zh_hant: 石鼓洲人工島廢物轉化能源設施三級火　無人受傷
title.zh_hans: 石鼓洲人工岛废物转化能源设施三级火　无人受伤

summary.en: A fire broke out at the Integrated Waste Management Facilities Phase I, known as I·PARK1, on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau at 12.43pm on Monday and was upgraded to a No. 3 alarm at 1.24pm. Firefighters are using two jets and have mobilised two breathing apparatus teams to fight the blaze, and no casualties have been reported so far. In a special announcement, the Fire Services Department advised members of the public affected by smoke and an unusual odour carried by the wind to close their doors and windows and stay calm.
summary.zh_hant: 石鼓洲對開人工島的綜合廢物管理設施第一期（I·PARK1）今日中午12時43分發生火警，下午1時24分升為三級火。消防員正用兩條喉及出動兩隊煙帽隊灌救，至今無人受傷。消防處發出特別宣布，呼籲受煙霧及隨風飄散異味影響的市民關好門窗、保持鎮定。

summary.en: Brazilian Senator Flávio Bolsonaro has refused to concede defeat to President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, who won a fourth non-consecutive term by about 4.4 million votes, and said he will seek the annulment of the presidential runoff. Bolsonaro called a Supreme Court ruling by Justice Cristiano Zanin extending voting by two hours 'unacceptable', saying it was 'impossible to recognise the election result'. Both camps had asked for longer voting hours because of public transport problems and bad weather, and the head of the electoral court said the extension had no impact on the result. Legal experts said there is no solid legal basis for annulment, although Bolsonaro may also request a recount if he has evidence of fraud.
summary.zh_hant: 巴西參議員博索納羅拒絕承認敗給總統盧拉，盧拉以約440萬票優勢歷史性第四度當選總統；博索納羅表示將尋求推翻次輪投票結果。他批評最高法院法官薩寧將投票時間延長兩小時的裁決「不可接受」，稱「不可能承認選舉結果」。由於公共交通問題及部分地區天氣惡劣，兩邊陣營當時都曾要求延長投票時間，選舉法院院長表示延長投票對結果並無影響。法律專家指出，推翻選舉結果缺乏堅實法律依據，不過博索納羅若有舞弊證據，亦可要求重新點票。
summary.zh_hans: 巴西参议员博索纳罗拒绝承认败给总统卢拉，卢拉以约440万票优势历史性第四度当选总统；博索纳罗表示将寻求推翻次轮投票结果。他批评最高法院法官萨宁将投票时间延长两小时的裁决「不可接受」，称「不可能承认选举结果」。由于公共交通问题及部分地区天气恶劣，两边阵营当时都曾要求延长投票时间，选举法院院长表示延长投票对结果并无影响。法律专家指出，推翻选举结果缺乏坚实法律依据，不过博索纳罗若有舞弊证据，亦可要求重新点票。

summary.en: Hong Kong stocks opened higher on Monday, with the Hang Seng Index up 63 points, or 0.28 per cent, at 23,156, while the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 0.43 per cent to 3,888 and the China Enterprises Index added 0.28 per cent to 7,777. Markets elsewhere in Asia slipped: Japan's Nikkei opened 243 points lower at 62,449, South Korea's Kospi fell 51 points to 5,499, and the Shanghai Composite opened 19 points lower at 3,671. Investors are growing worried about whether the huge sums poured into artificial intelligence will deliver returns, with earnings from Amazon, Microsoft and Alphabet due this week alongside South Korean chipmakers SK hynix and Samsung, after results from Tesla and Meta last week stoked spending concerns.

summary.en: The Belt and Road Green Innovation Conference 2026 was held in Hong Kong on Monday, the first time the event has taken place in the city, bringing together more than 400 political and business leaders, international organisation representatives and experts from 17 Belt and Road countries and about 40 Mainland provinces and cities. Under the theme of partnering with the Global South on green transition, participants exchanged views on green finance, green innovation and digital empowerment. summary.en: The fire at the I.PARK1 waste incinerator on an artificial island off Shek Kwu Chau was largely put out at about 4.45pm on Monday, the Environmental Protection Department said in a follow-up statement. Preliminary findings point to the roof of the main incinerator building's third incineration module as the fire's origin; about 970 construction workers and operational staff were evacuated in an orderly manner and one staff member felt unwell and was sent to hospital. summary.en: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority has warned the public about a fraudulent loan scheme that falsely claims to be related to its e-HKD project, after receiving a large number of public enquiries. Firms in the e-HKD pilot programme and other HKMA sandbox programmes will not solicit funding from the public, and the cases have been reported to police.

summary.en: The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department took away a dog from a warehouse on Kam Pok Road in Yuen Long on Monday morning after police referred a suspected dog bite case, and sent the animal to an animal management centre for detention and observation. The dog is a microchipped mongrel with a valid licence; the department is investigating and will prosecute if there is sufficient evidence. The department reminded keepers that dogs in public places must be held on a leash or otherwise kept under proper control, with fines of up to $10,000, and up to $25,000 and three months' jail for large dogs not properly leashed.

summary.en: The Legislative Council Secretariat has released the latest issue of its Policy Pulse on developing Hong Kong into an international health and medical innovation hub, covering reform of the drug and medical device regulatory regime and the promotion of Chinese medicine. The paper notes Hong Kong is the largest biotechnology fundraising platform in Asia-Pacific and the second largest globally, that around one-third of the strategic enterprises attracted by the Office for Attracting Strategic Enterprises are in life and health technology, and that the Government plans to submit a bill by the end of the year to set up the Hong Kong Centre for Medical Products Regulation. Members urged the Government to speed up the 'primary evaluation' mechanism for new drugs and to make Hong Kong one of the world's first-launch markets for new medicines.
summary.zh_hans: 立法会秘书处今日发表新一期《政策脉搏》，主题为发展国际健康及医疗创新枢纽，介绍香港改革药械监管制度及推动中医药传承创新的措施和最新进展，并综述议员的讨论和建议。文件指出，香港是亚太区最大、全球第二大的生物科技集资平台，驻港引进重点企业办公室引进的重点企业中约三分之一来自生命健康科技；政府计划年底前向立法会提交条例草案，成立香港药物及医疗器械监督管理中心。议员促请政府加快落实新药「第一层审批」机制，让香港成为全球新药首发市场之一。
summary.zh_hant: 立法會秘書處今日發表新一期《政策脈搏》，主題為發展國際健康及醫療創新樞紐，介紹香港改革藥械監管制度及推動中醫藥傳承創新的措施和最新進展，並綜述議員的討論和建議。文件指出，香港是亞太區最大、全球第二大的生物科技集資平台，駐港引進重點企業辦公室引進的重點企業中約三分之一來自生命健康科技；政府計劃年底前向立法會提交條例草案，成立香港藥物及醫療器械監督管理中心。議員促請政府加快落實新藥「第一層審批」機制，讓香港成為全球新藥首發市場之一。

summary.en: The Task Group on New Medical School held its fifth meeting on Monday to hear a progress report from the Hong Kong University of Science and Technology on preparations for the city's third medical school. HKUST has put forward a staffing plan for 2026 to 2030, proposed the framework for a four-year graduate-entry medical programme, and will use Kai Tak Hospital as its interim teaching hospital; its Medical Education and Research Complex on the Clear Water Bay campus is expected to be completed by 2028. The Government and HKUST have signed a memorandum of understanding covering funding, accreditation, teaching and capital works, with the first cohort of 50 students due to be admitted in the 2028/29 academic year.
summary.zh_hans: 新医学院专责小组今日举行第五次会议，听取香港科技大学汇报筹建本港第三所医学院的进度。科大已提出2026至2030年学术及行政人员编制计划，并建议四年制研究生医学课程的整体框架及科目大纲，将以启德医院作为临时教学医院；清水湾校园的医学教育及研究大楼预计2028年落成。政府与科大已签署谅解备忘录，涵盖财政安排、课程认证、临床教学及基建工程，目标2028/29学年招收首届50名学生。
summary.zh_hant: 新醫學院專責小組今日舉行第五次會議，聽取香港科技大學匯報籌建本港第三所醫學院的進度。科大已提出2026至2030年學術及行政人員編制計劃，並建議四年制研究生醫學課程的整體框架及科目大綱，將以啟德醫院作為臨時教學醫院；清水灣校園的醫學教育及研究大樓預計2028年落成。政府與科大已簽署諒解備忘錄，涵蓋財政安排、課程認證、臨床教學及基建工程，目標2028/29學年招收首屆50名學生。

summary.en: Serbia's student-backed opposition has won Sunday's snap parliamentary election, with President Aleksandar Vucic conceding defeat on election night after preliminary projections gave the Student List a majority in the 250-seat National Assembly. Projections put the Student List at 135 to 140 seats against about 105 for Vucic's Serbian Progressive Party-led bloc, and a preliminary count of 96.9 per cent of polling stations gave the students 53.3 per cent of the vote. Turnout reached 68.8 per cent, about ten points higher than in 2023, in an election that followed nearly two years of student-led anti-corruption protests after the 2024 Novi Sad station canopy collapse that killed 16 people.

summary.zh_hant: 塞爾維亞學生支持的反對派在星期日的提前國會選舉中勝出，總統武契奇在選舉之夜承認落敗。初步預測顯示，學生名單將在250席的國民議會中取得135至140席，對手進步黨聯盟約105席；已點算96.9%票站的初步結果顯示，學生名單得票53.3%。今次投票率達68.8%，較2023年高約十個百分點。選舉源於2024年諾維薩德車站天篷倒塌致16人死亡後、持續近兩年的學生反貪抗議運動。

summary.en: The Securities and Futures Commission has approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on a licensed virtual asset trading platform, with round-the-clock trading of two tokenised money market funds beginning on Monday. The approval builds on a regulatory framework introduced in April covering trading operations, fair pricing, liquidity provision and disclosure, and applies to two existing SFC-authorised tokenised money market funds from ChinaAMC. The SFC said tokenised public funds could in future connect with tokenised deposit capabilities under Project Ensemble with the HKMA, and that it will monitor trading closely and consider widening the product range over time.

summary.en: Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing has launched two new thematic indices covering artificial intelligence and semiconductors, expanding its proprietary index series for institutional and retail investors. HKEX said artificial intelligence and semiconductors have become primary drivers of global growth, and the partnership will broaden investment options while boosting liquidity and market depth across Hong Kong and the mainland.

summary.en: The Centre for Food Safety has suspended imports of poultry meat and products, including eggs, from Slagelse Municipality in Denmark with immediate effect, after the World Organisation for Animal Health reported an outbreak of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza there. The centre said it has contacted the Danish authorities and will monitor the situation closely.

summary.en: The Centre for Health Protection recorded three community-acquired Legionnaires' disease cases between October 18 and 24, involving men aged 36 to 83 living in Yuen Long, Kwai Tsing and Tuen Mun. Initial investigations found the cases were sporadic, with no epidemiological links to other confirmed cases. As of October 24, 163 cases had been recorded this year, compared with 167 in 2025 and 135 in 2024. The department reminded the public to maintain water systems properly and urged susceptible groups to take precautions.

summary.en: Hong Kong is preparing to issue its first ride-hailing platform licences as early as late November, bringing an industry that has operated in a legal grey area for years under formal regulation. About 16,000 people have registered for the city's new combined taxi and ride-hailing written test, with a pass rate of more than 60 per cent, Transport and Logistics Secretary Mable Chan said. summary.en: India's weather department has issued a red-message cyclone warning for the Andhra Pradesh and adjoining south Odisha coasts as Cyclone Arnab is expected to strengthen into a very severe cyclonic storm on October 27. The storm is forecast to cross the Andhra Pradesh and Yanam coasts between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam by the morning of October 28, with maximum sustained winds of 115 to 125 kilometres per hour and gusts up to 140. Odisha has closed schools in vulnerable districts on October 28 and 29, banned sea fishing and deployed disaster response teams as part of a zero-casualty plan.

summary.en: Hong Kong Science and Technology Parks Corporation and Merck have signed a collaboration agreement to establish the Merck Hong Kong Centre at Hong Kong Science Park. The centre will give park startups and researchers access to advanced scientific products, live technology demonstrations and expert consultation, alongside technical training, clinical advisory sessions and an innovation scouting programme. summary.en: China's Communist Party has opened a four-day meeting of its Central Committee in Beijing, with President Xi Jinping briefing senior cadres on a draft document centred on 'full and rigorous party self-governance'. State news agency Xinhua said the document addresses the challenges facing the party, including strengthening its governing capacity, guarding against complacency and combating corruption. The meeting runs until Thursday and is the fifth plenum since the current Central Committee was formed in 2022. Analysts say it is likely the last major party gathering before a leadership reshuffle in 2027, when Xi is expected to seek a fourth term.
summary.zh_hans: 中共中央委员会星期一在北京召开为期四日的五中全会，国家主席习近平向高层干部介绍一份以「全面从严治党」为中心的文件草案。据新华社报道，文件针对党面临的挑战，包括提升管治能力、防止自满松懈及打击贪腐。会议将举行至星期四，是本届中央委员会自2022年组成以来第五次全会。分析认为，这可能是2027年领导层换届前最后一次重要党内会议，习近平预料将寻求第四个任期。

summary.en: Authorities in Andhra Pradesh have identified about 570,000 people in high-risk coastal and low-lying areas for evacuation as Cyclone Arnab approaches the eastern coast of India, with the evacuation due to begin on Monday evening. The cyclone is expected to strengthen into a very severe cyclonic storm on Tuesday before making landfall between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam on Wednesday morning, bringing sustained winds of 115 to 125 kilometres per hour. Power utilities in the state are on high alert and have stockpiled 25,000 electricity poles and other materials to restore supply quickly after any disruption. In neighbouring Odisha, about 20 disaster response teams have been deployed, with a three-phase plan to field 60 teams, and schools in five vulnerable districts will close on Wednesday and Thursday.

summary.en: Singer Charli XCX is adding another film role to her acting career, joining the cast of Martin Scorsese's upcoming gothic psychological drama 'What Happens at Night'.
